## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] I ran `npm run e2e` (or this change does not alter what the browser shows)
- [ ] New interface text goes through `t()` and is in all 15 language files (`npm run i18n:add`)
- [ ] A case change cites sources, and `npm run verify:media` passes
- [ ] A new data source is listed in `DATA_SOURCES.md`, and needs no key
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `AGENTS.md`) and, for a release, `npm run build:changelog`
